about: The month and day a term starts after its election where the office's own start rule is not carried on the office (federal offices carry theirs: January 20, January 3). Read by src/core2/elections-calendar.ts termStartAfter. Rows are keyed by state and office family; the default stands in where a state's rule is not yet read (SG-GOV-term-end-estimate).

default.estimatedFrom: Most state and local terms begin in early January after the November election (state constitutions and charters); the exact day varies by state and is not yet read.
